sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM scale.sales_scale_1000
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scale.sales_scale_1000 GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC
SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM scale.sales_scale_1000 GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_amount DESC, region ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM scale.sales_scale_1000 WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND sale_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM scale.sales_scale_1000 WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND sale_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM scale.sales_scale_1000 WHERE region = '华东' AND sale_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND sale_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
SELECT product_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM scale.sales_scale_1000 GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', sale_date)::date AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM scale.sales_scale_1000 WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND sale_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, MIN(unit_price) AS min_unit_price, MAX(unit_price) AS max_unit_price FROM scale.sales_scale_1000
SELECT sale_id, amount FROM scale.sales_scale_1000 ORDER BY amount DESC, sale_id ASC LIMIT 100
